title: UniFi Overview
description: UniFi metrics exported by the live-home-page backend (/metrics).

panels.title: Firing / pending UniFi alerts

panels.title: WAN uptime (24h)

panels.description: 1 = issue active. Issues come from the UniFi cloud API; 'wan down' from the local controller.

panels.title: Throughput per device
panels.description: APs and switches (the gateway is shown above). tx drawn below the axis.
